summary: Iteration 2 backend regression + new-feature verification. All 49 pytest cases pass (47 from iter_1 + 2 new for iter_2 changes; plus extended assertions on request-otp and upload envelope). Verified: (a) POST /auth/request-otp now returns data.delivery='console' AND data.dev_otp usable by verify-otp; (b) POST /uploads/image response envelope now includes data.provider='filesystem' and data.key starting with {org_id}/; (c) file still fetchable via GET /uploads/file/{org}/{name} on the public BASE_URL and returns valid PNG bytes; (d) non-image MIME and fake magic-bytes still rejected (400), size limit path unchanged; (e) Kanban PATCH /projects/{pid}/tasks/{tid} still moves todo->in_progress->done for PM, and site_engineer done->in_progress is STILL rejected with 403 (test_site_engineer_cannot_revert_status); (f) /api/v1/health returns 200 confirming lifespan validate_startup_config() passed with defaults (OTP_DELIVERY_TYPE=console, STORAGE_TYPE=filesystem); (g) /api/v1/docs and /api/v1/openapi.json load and contain /api/v1/auth/request-otp path. Provider defaults unchanged as required — no code edits to app source, only added/extended tests.

minor.issue: data.url is built from request.base_url which resolves to the internal cluster hostname (http://<host>.cluster-11.preview.emergentcf.cloud/...) and returns 403 via the edge. Files ARE reachable on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (200 image/png). Pre-existing behavior from iteration_1, not a regression, but frontends/mobile that consume data.url as-is will get 403. Recommend building the URL from FRONTEND_URL/PUBLIC_BASE_URL setting, or returning a relative path so the client can prefix with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

action_items: OPTIONAL: fix uploaded-file URL construction so data.url points at the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (or return a path-only URL). Currently the returned URL uses the internal cluster hostname and 403s from outside.
OPTIONAL: consider validating STORAGE_TYPE and OTP_DELIVERY_TYPE case-sensitively OR normalize both sides — currently normalized via .lower().strip() which is fine, just documented.
critical_code_review_comments: uploads.py — `url` built from request.base_url returns internal cluster host. This URL is echoed back to clients and stored in DB references (photos[]). Prefer FRONTEND_URL-based or relative URL, otherwise clients rendering the URL directly (mobile Expo app, browser) fail with 403. HIGH IMPACT on iteration_2 photo flow inside logs/tasks.
auth.py request-otp — good: `delivery` and `dev_mode` now always in payload, `dev_otp` only exposed when provider.exposes_dev_otp True. Consistent with playbook contract.

storage_provider.py path handling (filesystem) — get_file_url is fine, but consider adding a `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` setting to avoid depending on request context (works for background tasks or non-HTTP callers).
config.validate_startup_config() — good fail-fast on sendgrid/s3 missing credentials. Consider also validating UPLOAD_DIR is writable when STORAGE_TYPE=filesystem to catch permission issues early.

uploads.py get_file — traversal check is now BEFORE FileResponse construction (good, fixed since iter_1 review comment). But it still doesn't restrict access by X-Org-Id — any authenticated OR unauthenticated caller who knows the {org_id}/{filename} pair can fetch. If images may contain PII (site photos), consider gating GET by auth + org membership, or make keys unguessable (they already are UUID4 which is fine for now).
server.py CORS — unchanged, still `allow_origins=['*']` with credentials=False. Fine for preview but if mobile app moves to cookie-based auth, this breaks.
